## Natural history notes

A small lichen moth characterized by narrow wings with pale yellow to orange coloration crossed by dark gray or black streaks and bands. In Florida, it is found in forests, hammocks, pine flatwoods, gardens, parks, and other habitats where lichens and algae grow on tree trunks, branches, or other surfaces. Adults may visit flowers or rest on vegetation, while the caterpillars feed on lichens, algae, and related surface growths, helping link bark-dwelling fungal communities with insect food webs.
